findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are stored in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived credentials to anyone with read access to the function configuration, Terraform state, console/API, or CI/CD logs.

findings.issue_category: missing encryption at rest for environment variables
findings.description: No kms_key_arn is specified for the Lambda function, so environment variables (including the embedded secrets) are only protected by the default AWS-managed key rather than a customer-managed key with tighter access control, weakening protection of sensitive data at rest.
The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life Node.js runtime that no longer receives security patches, increasing exposure to known unpatched vulnerabilities.
